market_question: Will Dawn Buckingham win the 2026 Texas Republican Primary?
reasoning: The market implies a 0.1% chance for Buckingham, which is severely underpriced given her statewide name recognition as Texas Land Commissioner and a path to victory in a fragmented primary. Even as a clear underdog to Ken Paxton, her true probability is realistically in the 2-5% range, yielding a large edge on the Yes side.
evidence_points: Buckingham is a sitting statewide elected official with strong name ID among GOP primary voters.
Early polling (Jan 2025) shows her support around 5-10% in a hypothetical Senate primary field, well above 0.1%.
Ken Paxton, while dominant, has legal vulnerabilities; a scandal or indictment could reshuffle the race, dramatically improving Buckingham's odds.
Long-shot candidates in political prediction markets often trade below their true probability due to favorite bias.
sources_consulted: Texas GOP primary polling data (January 2025 survey)
